moves.about: whether a hissing raḥam on the ground really signals the Messiah, given the one that was killed by a stone

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: ההוא ביידא הוה
moves.summary: that one was a liar and was punished for it
moves.about: that particular raḥam was a liar and was punished for it

moves.cueHe: תנו רבנן: ״עורב״ – זה עורב
moves.summary: the crow verse expounded as including the valley crow and the pigeon-headed crow
moves.about: what the extra words of the crow verse include — the valley crow and the crow with a pigeon's head

moves.cueHe: אטו קמן קאי?
moves.summary: 'this is the crow' identifies nothing, since no crow stands before us
moves.about: how 'this is the crow' identifies anything, since no crow is standing before us to point at

moves.cueHe: אלא אימא: ״עורב״ – זה עורב אוכמא
moves.summary: read it as the black crow, the valley crow being the white one, each with a verse
moves.about: taking up the baraita's opening clause for analysis

moves.cueHe: אמר רב פפא: לא תימא דאתי בריש יוני
moves.summary: the crow 'at the heads of pigeons' is one whose head resembles a pigeon's
moves.about: what the baraita's 'crow that comes at the heads of pigeons' means — its head resembles a pigeon's

moves.cueHe: תנו רבנן: ״הנץ״ – זה הנץ
moves.summary: 'after its kinds' on the hawk includes the bar ḥireya
moves.about: what 'after its kinds' adds to the hawk — the bar ḥireya

moves.cueHe: מאי בר חיריא?
moves.summary: which bird the bar ḥireya is
moves.about: which bird the baraita's bar ḥireya is

moves.cueHe: אמר אביי: שורינקא
moves.summary: it is the shurineka
moves.about: the bar ḥireya is the bird commonly called the shurineka

moves.cueHe: אמר רב יהודה: ״החסידה״ – זו דיה לבנה
moves.summary: identifies the ḥasida and anafa and derives their names from their conduct
moves.about: identifying the ḥasida and anafa and explaining their names from their behaviour

moves.cueHe: אמר רב חנן בר רב חסדא אמר רב חסדא
moves.summary: a four-link chain up to Rav: there are twenty-four non-kosher birds
moves.about: the tradition that there are twenty-four non-kosher birds

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה רב חנן בר רב חסדא לרב חסדא: דהיכא?
moves.summary: he asks his father where in the Torah the twenty-four are found
moves.about: where in the Torah the count of twenty-four non-kosher birds is found

moves.cueHe: אי דויקרא – עשרים הוו
moves.summary: neither list reaches twenty-four: Leviticus has twenty, Deuteronomy twenty-one
moves.about: neither list in the Torah yields twenty-four — Leviticus has twenty and Deuteronomy twenty-one

moves.cueHe: וכי תימא דאה דכתיבא בויקרא
moves.summary: adding the da'a to the Deuteronomy list still gives only twenty-two
moves.about: adding the da'a of Leviticus to the Deuteronomy list still yields only twenty-two

moves.cueHe: אמר ליה: הכי אמר אבוה דאמך משמיה דרב
moves.summary: the four occurrences of 'after its kinds' supply four more
moves.about: the four occurrences of 'after its kinds' that supply the missing four birds

moves.cueHe: אי הכי עשרין ושית הוו?
moves.summary: that yields twenty-six, not twenty-four
moves.about: adding four to the twenty-two yields twenty-six, not twenty-four

moves.cueHe: אמר אביי: דאה וראה אחת היא
moves.summary: the da'a and ra'a are one species
moves.about: the da'a of Leviticus and the ra'a of Deuteronomy are one species, so the count drops by one

moves.cueHe: אלא שמע מינה מין ראה ודאה אחת היא
moves.summary: since Deuteronomy comes to add, the substitution proves the two are one
moves.about: since Deuteronomy comes to add, the substitution of ra'a for da'a shows the two are one species

moves.cueHe: ואכתי עשרין וחמשה הוו?
moves.summary: the count still stands at twenty-five
moves.about: even after merging da'a and ra'a the count is twenty-five, not twenty-four

moves.cueHe: אמר אביי: כשם שראה ודאה אחת היא, כך איה ודיה אחת היא
moves.summary: the ayya and dayya are likewise one, by the same argument from 'after its kinds'
moves.about: the ayya and the dayya are likewise one species, since 'after its kinds' attaches to each in only one list

moves.cueHe: וכי מאחר שאיה ודיה אחת היא, למה ליה למיכתב איה ודיה?
moves.summary: why then does the Torah write both names
moves.about: why the Torah wrote both ayya and dayya if they are one species

moves.cueHe: כדתניא, רבי אומר: אקרא אני איה
moves.summary: both are written so that no one can permit the bird by calling it the other name
moves.about: both names are written so that no one can claim the bird he calls by the other name is permitted

moves.cueHe: מיתיבי: למה נשנו?
moves.summary: a baraita pairs the repeated bird list with the repeated animal list, which does add a species
moves.about: whether the repeated bird list in Deuteronomy adds a species, as the repeated animal list does

moves.cueHe: לא, התם – לאוסופי, הכא – לפרושי
moves.summary: the animal list adds, the bird list only explains
moves.about: the animal list is repeated to add, the bird list only to explain

moves.cueHe: ופליגא דרבי אבהו, דאמר רבי אבהו: ראה זו איה
moves.summary: R' Abbahu pairs ra'a with ayya instead, and derives the name from its keen sight
moves.about: which of the Torah's bird names are duplicates, and hence how many non-kosher species the Torah lists

edges.cueHe: לא צריכא, דחתוכות
edges.about: the gentile is relied on only where the eggs are already cut, so their shape cannot be seen

edges.cueHe: וליבדוק בחלמון וחלבון?
edges.about: even cut eggs could be inspected by which of yolk and albumen lies outside

edges.cueHe: בטרופות בקערה
edges.about: the eggs are beaten together in a bowl, so yolk and albumen cannot be told apart

edges.cueHe: וכהאי גוונא מי זבנינן מינייהו? והא תניא
edges.about: beaten eggs may not be bought from gentiles at all, per the baraita on selling a tereifa's egg

edges.cueHe: והא תניא
edges.about: the baraita on selling a tereifa's egg to a gentile only when beaten

edges.cueHe: אלא אמר רבי זירא: סימנין לאו דאורייתא
edges.about: the egg signs are not of Torah force, which is why the gentile's word is needed

edges.cueHe: הא דאמר רב אסי: שמנה ספיקות הן
edges.about: Rav Asi's eight uncertain birds, whose status could have been settled by inspecting their eggs if the signs were of Torah force

edges.cueHe: אלא שמע מינה: סימנין לאו דאורייתא
edges.about: from Rav Asi's standing uncertainty one concludes the egg signs are not of Torah force

edges.cueHe: אלא למאי הלכתא קתני לה?
edges.about: for what halakha the baraita teaches the egg signs if they may not be relied on

edges.cueHe: הכי קאמר
edges.about: the baraita's signs establish certain non-kashrut, and permit only together with the gentile's naming of the species

edges.cueHe: אמר מר: חלבון וחלמון מעורבין זה בזה – בידוע שהיא ביצת השרץ
edges.about: taking up the baraita's clause on the mixed yolk and albumen

edges.cueHe: למאי הלכתא?
edges.about: what halakha turns on identifying the egg specifically as a creeping animal's, since either way it is forbidden

edges.cueHe: אמר רב עוקבא בר חמא: לומר שאם ריקמה וניקבה בכעדשה – מטמא
edges.about: such an egg, if an embryo developed and it was perforated, transmits ritual impurity at a lentil-bulk

edges.cueHe: מתקיף לה רבינא: ודלמא דנחש היא?
edges.about: the egg may be a snake's, whose carcass does not transmit impurity, so impurity cannot be the point

edges.cueHe: אלא אמר רבא: שאם ריקמה ואכלה – לוקה עליה
edges.about: the clause teaches liability to lashes for eating such an egg once an embryo has developed

edges.cueHe: משום ״שרץ השורץ על הארץ״
edges.about: the prohibition of swarming things as the ground of the lashes

edges.cueHe: אי הכי, מאי איריא דטמאה? אפילו דטהורה נמי!
edges.about: why the clause singles out a non-kosher creature's egg, when eating a developed embryo of a kosher bird also carries lashes

edges.cueHe: דתניא
edges.about: the baraita including unopened-eyed chicks in the prohibition of swarming things

edges.cueHe: לרבות אפרוחים שלא נפתחו עיניהם
edges.about: what the verse's phrase includes — chicks whose eyes have not yet opened

edges.cueHe: מדרבנן, וקרא אסמכתא בעלמא
edges.about: the prohibition on kosher chicks is only rabbinic and the verse is a mere support, so lashes apply only to the creeping animal's egg

edges.cueHe: תנו רבנן: גיעולי ביצים מותרות
edges.about: the baraita on boiled eggs, unfertilized eggs and a drop of blood

edges.cueHe: אמר רבי ירמיה: והוא שנמצא על קשר שלה
edges.about: the rest of the egg is permitted only when the blood is found on the egg's knot

edges.cueHe: תני דוסתאי אבוה דרבי אפטוריקי
edges.about: a baraita distinguishing blood found on the albumen from blood found on the yolk

edges.cueHe: לא שנו אלא שנמצא על חלבון שלה, אבל נמצא על חלמון שלה
edges.about: the baraita's permission applies only to blood on the albumen, not on the yolk

edges.cueHe: לא שנו אלא שנמצא על חלבון שלה
edges.about: whether the rest of the egg is permitted only when the blood lies at the knot in the albumen

edges.cueHe: מאי טעמא?
edges.about: why blood on the yolk forbids the whole egg

edges.cueHe: דשדא תכלא בכולה
edges.about: blood on the yolk shows the decay has spread through the whole egg

edges.cueHe: אמר ליה רב גביהה מבי כתיל לרב אשי: איפכא תני תנא קמיה דאביי
edges.about: that the tanna recited the reverse before Abaye, and that it was Abaye who corrected it into the version Dostai teaches

edges.cueHe: תני תנא קמיה דאביי

edges.cueHe: ואביי הוא דתרצה ניהליה הכי
edges.about: Abaye reversed the reciter's version into the form Dostai teaches

edges.cueHe: שנאמר: ״ואת בת היענה״
edges.about: the phrase 'the daughter of the ya'ana' as the source forbidding a non-kosher bird's egg

edges.cueHe: וכי בת יש לה ליענה? אלא איזו – זו ביצה טמאה
edges.about: the ya'ana has no 'daughter' whose status would differ, so 'daughter' must denote its egg

edges.cueHe: ודלמא היינו שמייהו?
edges.about: perhaps bat ya'ana is simply the bird's name, so nothing about eggs is derived

edges.cueHe: לא סלקא דעתך, דכתיב: ״בת עמי לאכזר כיענים במדבר״
edges.about: proof that the bird's name is simply ya'ana

edges.cueHe: ולא? והא כתיב: ״אעשה מספד כתנים ואבל כבנות יענה״?
edges.about: verses that speak of benot ya'ana suggest that is the bird's name after all

edges.cueHe: והא כתיב: ״אעשה מספד כתנים ואבל כבנות יענה״
edges.about: the verse about mourning like the daughters of the ya'ana

edges.cueHe: כיענה זו שמתאבלת על בניה
edges.about: the verse means mourning like the ya'ana that mourns for its young

edges.cueHe: והא כתיב: ״ושכנו שם בנות יענה״?
edges.about: another verse speaking of benot ya'ana dwelling in the ruins

edges.cueHe: ״ושכנו שם בנות יענה״
edges.about: the verse about benot ya'ana dwelling in the ruins

edges.cueHe: כיענה זו ששוכנת עם בניה
edges.about: the verse means they shall dwell like the ya'ana that dwells with its young

edges.cueHe: והכתיב: ״תכבדני חית השדה תנים ובנות יענה״
edges.about: an egg cannot sing God's praise, so benot ya'ana in Isaiah must be birds and hence a name

edges.cueHe: ״תכבדני חית השדה תנים ובנות יענה״
edges.about: the verse in which the benot ya'ana honour God

edges.cueHe: אלא, כתיב ״היענה״, וכתיב ״בת היענה״
edges.about: both ya'ana and bat ya'ana are acceptable names for the bird

edges.cueHe: ושאני הכא, דפסק ספרא לשתי תיבות
edges.about: Ḥizkiya's derivation still stands because here the scribe writes the name as two separate words

edges.cueHe: שמע מינה תרי שמות נינהו
edges.about: the scribal separation shows bat and ya'ana are two names, so the egg is included in the prohibition

edges.cueHe: אלא מעתה ״את כדר לעומר״ דפסק להו ספרא בתרי, הכי נמי דתרי שמי נינהו?
edges.about: Chedorlaomer is also written as two words yet is plainly one name

edges.cueHe: ״את כדר לעומר״
edges.about: the name Chedorlaomer written as two words

edges.cueHe: אמרי: התם בשתי תיבות פסיק להו, בשני שיטין לא פסיק להו
edges.about: Chedorlaomer is split into two words but never across two lines, whereas bat ya'ana may be
